mentions.name: meepr
mentions.description: A micro-blogging platform, essentially an early version of Twitter, with a gated hashtag system. It builds a knowledge base of what users talk about and how deeply, then lets them post into or create hashtags. It has no recommendations, no algorithmic timeline, and no ads — regular micro-blogging with a twist.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built meepr recently. It's basically twitter v1, but the hashtag system is gated, it builds a knowledge base of what you talk about and how deeply, and then enables you to post into/create hashtags, think of twitter meets reddit meets quora? Feel free to follow me and share with your friends. No recommendations, no algorithmic timeline, no ads etc.
